entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as learned counsel for the informant and perused the record.
Learned counsel Ms. R.U. Rinki Renu on behalf of High Court Legal Services Committe is also present.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant in Case Crime No. 128 of 2020,
under Sections 376, 328, 506 of IPC and Section 3/4 of P.O.C.S.O. Act, Police Station Asothar,
District Fatehpur with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

It is submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated for the reason that the applicant was doing pairvi in the case of first informant which was also lodged by first informant having Case Crime No.- 179 of 2014 under Section 376, 302, 201, 304 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act.

It is further submitted that the victim was unconscious while the brother Kallu who is alleged to accompanied to the victim was in consciousness but his statement was not recorded by the Investigating Officer.
No adverse finding has been found in the medical examination.

It is further submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 12.10.2020 having no criminal history and that in case he is released on Vinod Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165631319/
1 bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.

entities.text: Vinod Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Per contra learned AGA assisted by Sri Shyam Sundar Mishra learned counsel for the informant and Ms. R.U. Rinki Renu learned counsel on behalf of the High Court Legal Services Committee,
opposed the prayer for grant of bail submitted that the victim has corroborated the version of the first information report in her statement recorded under Section 161 and 164 CrPC.
There is no reason for false implication since no documents relating to the alleged falsification is filed on behalf of the applicant.
The age of the Victim is determined to be 15 years and she is a minor girl.
It is further submitted the nature of the crime is heinous.
It is further submitted that at the time of medical examination the victim narrated the same version and stated according to the prosecution.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of allegations and gravity of offence, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the opinion that no case for grant of bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby rejected
Any observation made above shall not be treated as any finding on the merit and shall not prejudice the trial.

Order Date :- 19.1.2023 VK Bharteey  Vinod Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165631319/
